in_marathi.name: Nivaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nivaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niv' which means 'to rest' and 'An' meaning 'against'. The name symbolizes a person who has overcome all obstacles and has reached a state of rest or peace. It is a name for those who have progressed in life and have attained success and stability.
